hints.BEL: 2009 年政府否決新建燃煤電廠，最後一座（Langerlo）2016 年 3 月停燒
hints.BGR: 計畫 2038 年關閉，但一般認為市場會讓它更早關
hints.FIN: 最後一座大型燃煤電廠 2025 年退役；兩座生質與燃煤混燒的電廠還燒最多 30% 的煤
hints.ITA: 2025 年本土停用燃煤，只剩薩丁尼亞，預計 2038 年
hints.ESP: 2025 年本土最後一座燃煤電廠停機，只剩馬約卡島的 Es Murterar
hints.USA: 2035 年是拜登政府「2035 年電力無碳」的目標（Ember 引用）；2025 年上任的川普政府改為支持燃煤電廠繼續運轉
hints.VNM: 2021 年 COP26 承諾 2040 年代或稍後停用沒有減排設備的燃煤發電（條目的越南一節）

hintsEn.BEL: The last plant, Langerlo, burned its last coal in March 2016
hintsEn.BGR: Closure planned for 2038, though market forces are expected to bring it forward
hintsEn.FIN: The last major coal plant retired in 2025; two biomass plants still co-fire up to 30% coal
hintsEn.ITA: Coal-free on the mainland since 2025 except Sardinia, expected by 2038
hintsEn.ESP: The last mainland plant closed in 2025; only Es Murterar on Mallorca remains
hintsEn.DEU: The latest date set by law
hintsEn.USA: 2035 is the Biden administration's goal of a carbon-free power sector (as cited by Ember); the Trump administration that took office in 2025 instead backs keeping coal plants running
hintsEn.VNM: Pledged at COP26 in 2021 to phase out unabated coal power in the 2040s or soon after (the article's Vietnam section)

notes.TWN: 台灣沒有燃煤發電退場的年份，算「沒有承諾」。國發會《臺灣2050淨零排放路徑及策略總說明》（2022-03-30）：短期不再興建新的燃煤電廠（第 9 頁）；燃煤機組短期混燒氨，長期提高混燒率或搭配碳捕捉，並視低碳能源的供給，基於國家安全把未屆齡的燃煤機組轉為備用（第 15 頁）；2050 年的藍圖仍有 20–27% 搭配碳捕捉的火力發電（第 8 頁）。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan has no coal phase-out date and is counted as not committed. The National Development Council's 2050 net-zero pathway (30 March 2022) says no new coal plants will be built in the short term (p. 9); coal units will co-fire ammonia in the short term, raise co-firing or add carbon capture in the long term, and, as low-carbon supply grows, units not yet at retirement age will be moved to reserve for national security reasons (p. 15). The 2050 blueprint still has 20–27% of power from fossil plants with carbon capture (p. 8).
